android.desc: GIVE YOUR EYES A MUCH NEEDED REST Evie uses Text To Speech (TTS) technologies to transform written text into an audible narration. Evie is free. Really free, without any ads. You can use for as long as you want, with any Text To Speech engine you have on your phone. ENJOY THOSE BOOKS FOR WHICH YOU NEVER HAD TIME • Listen to a book while commuting • Listen to a book during your work-out • When working in your garden • Or go to sleep listening to a book AUDIO PLAYER FEATURES • Evie can read out loud even in background or with the screen turned off. • You can control playback with your earphones buttons, either Bluetooth or wired. • Evie integrates with your car stereo via Bluetooth. Play, Pause and Skip Forward or Backward from your car's buttons. • You can control it from your lock screen or from the notifications drawer. • Evie offers an Equaliser to fine tune the sound the way you like it. EVIE ON YOUR SMART WATCH Starting with version 16, Evie works on your Wear OS smart watch. This is feature requires an Internet connection and an Evie account. DISCOVER AN APP YOU CAN TRUST Evie does not require any permissions to run. It does not need access to your files, your contacts, or any other information and it does not read nor store cookies on your phone. TRY THE LIFE-LIKE AMAZON VOICES Evie integrates with Polly, the excellent TTS engine from Amazon. Polly is a cloud service that uses deep learning technologies to synthesize speech that sounds like a human voice. This is a paid feature, and requires an Evie account. Evie offers simple in-app purchases in a pay-as-you-go model. LEARN A FOREIGN LANGUAGE WITH EVIE Have Evie repeat each sentence multiple times, then optionally wait for you to repeat. The key to speaking the language is memorization through repetition. READ A BOOK IN A LANGUAGE YOU DON'T KNOW Evie can translate each sentence on the fly, then read the translation out loud to you. Evie uses the excellent Amazon Neural translation engine, supporting more than 70 languages. This is a paid feature, and requires an Evie account. Evie offers simple in-app purchases for in a pay-as-you-go model. You can use for free, with any TTS engine installed on your phone, if you don't want to use the Amazon voices.
